symptoms: The plant suddenly wilts and dies.
The whole plant turns yellow and stops growing.
The plant may wilt at noon and recover at night before finally dying.
The inside of the stem and roots turns brown.
favourable_conditions: High soil moisture and moderate soil temperatures help the disease grow.
prevention: Grow resistant varieties like Pant Samrat.
Rotate brinjal with crops like maize, soybean, wheat, rice, or cauliflower.
Use green manure crops like Brassica.
Keep the field clean and remove all old plant parts.
Control root knot nematodes in the soil.
practices: Remove and burn all affected plant parts.
Control root knot nematodes to stop the disease from spreading.

organic_bio.text: Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma viride 1% WP with 25 kg FYM and broadcast uniformly over an acre of land and irrigate the field immediately.
